name: Dinadan

attributes.attribute: the satirist of the ROUND TABLE
wore a dress during the tournament

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dinadan was an Arthurian hero. He acted as the satirist of the ROUND TABLE. He appears as a prankster in several Arthurian tales. Dinadan fought a tournament with LANCELOT. Lancelot wore a dress for the occasion. Dinadan lost. He then had to wear women's attire.
objective: Dinadan was the satirist of the ROUND TABLE. He appears as a prankster in Arthurian tales.
key_results: Dinadan lost a tournament to LANCELOT.
The loser had to wear women's attire.
evidence: Monaghan, The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
